champion.tips: BARD TIPS AND TRICKS The best time to pick up nearby Chimes is when there are no minions in lane about to die. Otherwise, you’ll fall behind in XP trying to pick them up. When playing against melee champions, try to use your empowered auto-attack on them every time they walk forward to last hit minions. Do not place your health shrines W in a position where the enemy can easily take them. But don’t place them too far away from where you can’t get to them quickly. Place them slightly behind you and the ADC.
champion.builds: THE BEST BARD BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Bard Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Electrocute as your keystone, followed by Cheap Shot, Deep Ward and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Celerity and Scorch in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Bloodsong as your first item, followed by Boots of Swiftness and Dead Man's Plate. For your last 3 items, you should build Liandry's Torment, Locket of the Iron Solari and finish with Vigilant Wardstone. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 52.7% winrate over 35 760 matches played. Optional Your second option for Bard Support build would be to take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Electrocute as your keystone, Cheap Shot, Deep Ward and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Celerity with Scorch in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Attack Speed in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Solstice Sleigh, which you should build first, followed by Boots of Swiftness as your second item and Dead Man's Plate as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Redemption, Locket of the Iron Solari and Vigilant Wardstone. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 52.1% win rate over 3 979 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Electrocute as your keystone, Cheap Shot, Deep Ward and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Celerity with Scorch in the secondary tree, as well as Attack Speed, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Celestial Opposition as your first item, then Boots of Swiftness as a second item and Redemption as a third item. You want to finish the build with Locket of the Iron Solari, Dead Man's Plate and Vigilant Wardstone. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 49.7% win rate across 3 296 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Bard Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, Unsealed Spellbook, Magical Footwear, Biscuit Delivery and Cosmic Insight as your primary rune tree, and Deep Ward with Relentless Hunter as your secondary tree. Use Attack Speed, Move Speed and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Celestial Opposition as your first item, then finish Boots of Swiftness as your second item, and Redemption as third item. The last 3 options are Locket of the Iron Solari, Vigilant Wardstone and Shurelya's Battlesong. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 49.2% win rate over 1 609 matches played. Situational Bard Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Bard build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Bard runes page.
